record_id.reason: CRED_LIC_NUM has 4313 distinct values across 4313 rows and is the ASIC credit licence number, so it uniquely identifies each row.

fields.reason: Register column holding the licensee's name as registered with ASIC. Punctuation such as 'PTY. LTD.' is left as published.
BN is the business name the licence is traded under. Only about 34% filled and holds one name per row.
Column mixes 11-digit ABNs (about 89%) with 9-digit ACNs. The abn transform keeps only checksum-valid 11-digit values and skips the rest.
Same mixed column mapped a second time with the acn transform for 9-digit values (about 8%). Shorter 7- and 8-digit values are not padded and are skipped (see needs_transform).
No explicit entity-type column in the source, so the suffix rule on the name is used. Names ending Pty Ltd, Limited or Ltd (including 'LTD.') give company; others give unknown.
APPR and SUSP are licence statuses (approved, suspended), mapped to the nearest entity status. This is a licence-level claim, not an entity registration status. No other raw values are present.
Locality column with suburb or city names matching the locality sample values.
State column with standard 2-3 letter codes (NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA).
Four-digit postcode column; the postcode transform restores any dropped leading zero.

unmapped.reason: Constant register-type label ('Credit Licence') with one distinct value. It carries no per-row information.
Australian Financial Services Licence number. No AFSL field exists in the ontology. Value 0 means none.
Free-text suspension or condition history. No ontology field; sparse (about 0.6% filled).
Geocoded latitude of the locality. Not an ontology field and not a source claim about the address text.
Geocoded longitude of the locality. Not an ontology field and not a source claim about the address text.
External dispute resolution scheme membership (AFCA, COSL, FOS). No ontology field.
Long free-text list of licence authorisations and conditions. No ontology field for licence scope.

needs_transform.why: Some ACNs appear with dropped leading zeros (7- and 8-digit values such as 9086917 and 60107593). Correct ACN mapping needs left-padding to 9 digits before the checksum, and no zero-padding transform exists. These values are currently skipped by acn.

source_reliability_basis: ASIC is the statutory regulator and this is its credit licensee register, so identity claims (name, ABN/ACN) are high-trust. Address is the registered licence address and is reliable but may be out of date. Classification is weaker because entity_type is inferred from name suffix and status is licence-level. The dataset has no contact fields, so contact is set to a neutral 0.5.
